subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------ACT.TR.
description: Chart on book p. 34 (WM-10). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the subject; ACT-TR (actual transformation) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is on a dotted line from the subject. From PHY-U-P: AFL (affinity alignment) and POL-CON (political consciousness). From AFL: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics). INFO-DE-B (information degrees) is on a dotted line from EXT-DYM. From INFO-DE-B: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
